_source: GENERATED by scripts/regen-workspace-specs.mjs from `theme-gates.mjs --list-json` — do not hand-edit

gates.desc: The client brief — goals + brand direction — exists before any build starts.
gates.name: discovery

gates.desc: The design system + store identity are set up before QA can mean anything.
gates.name: foundation

gates.desc: No API keys / tokens / secrets committed in the theme — a leak is a security incident.
gates.name: secret-scan

gates.desc: Page-speed budget (LCP/CLS) via Lighthouse — slow stores lose sales + ranking.
gates.name: performance

gates.desc: Structured data, canonical + meta tags present — so Google can find + rank the store.
gates.name: seo

gates.desc: Favicon + social-share (OG/Twitter) images — no broken icon, full preview on shares.
gates.name: social-assets

gates.desc: No broken internal links + a real 404 page with a way back — no dead ends.
gates.name: link-health

gates.desc: Migration redirect map is safe — no loops / dead targets that lose old URLs + SEO.
gates.name: redirects

gates.desc: Shopify theme-check passes — no Liquid/asset errors or bad-practice warnings.
gates.name: code-lint

gates.desc: No hardcoded content — every text/image/color is merchant-editable in the admin.
gates.name: editability

gates.desc: No unused assets, orphan sections, or duplicate files bloating the theme.
gates.name: dead-code

gates.desc: No CSS overflow / layout defects (100vw, no-wrap rows) that break the page width.
gates.name: layout

gates.desc: Colors / spacing / type stay on the design-system scale — no hardcoded hex/px.
gates.name: design-tokens

gates.desc: Store-wide style stays consistent — capped font sizes / weights / radii, no drift.
gates.name: consistency

gates.desc: Hits the niche's premium taste bar (DNA pack) — looks designed, not generic.
gates.name: design-quality

gates.desc: The design tokens actually render on the page, not just declared on paper.
gates.name: render-check

gates.desc: ≥70% of sections reuse the theme base before going custom — no over-building.
gates.name: section-reuse

gates.desc: A brand change regenerates the CSS so it cascades everywhere — edit once.
gates.name: brand-sync

gates.desc: Lens vision-judges the real rendered pixels — catches what code checks can't.
gates.name: visual-check

gates.desc: Sections feel like one page — consistent type scale, rhythm, alignment.
gates.name: section-consistency

gates.desc: Mobile-first: thumb-reach CTAs, tap-target sizes, no horizontal scroll.
gates.name: mobile

gates.desc: Live WCAG check (axe) on the rendered page — usable by everyone, legal-safe.
gates.name: accessibility

gates.desc: Pre-deploy a11y in the markup — alt text, labels, tap targets, before it ships.
gates.name: static-a11y

gates.desc: CRO mechanics: hero+CTA, working buy-path, trust signals, sticky add-to-cart.
gates.name: conversion

gates.desc: Prices come from live Shopify data, never hardcoded — no fraud risk, multi-currency.
gates.name: price-binding

gates.desc: Image weight / format + art-direction — fast LCP, right crop per device.
gates.name: imagery

gates.desc: The store actually works — clicks, add-to-cart, no JS / console errors.
gates.name: functionality

gates.desc: Blocks fake reviews / fabricated scarcity / fake countdowns — trustworthy + legal.
gates.name: honesty

gates.desc: No dev placeholders (lorem / TEST) + copy meets the quality bar.
gates.name: content-quality

gates.desc: Data-driven rules (team + per-store, JSON) — adds enforcement by appending a rule; auto-grown from real defects.
gates.name: rule-pack

gates.desc: Every text key exists in every locale — no untranslated fallbacks.
gates.name: translations

gates.desc: No clashing apps (popup wars, duplicate reviews) that break the storefront.
gates.name: app-conflicts

gates.desc: Every declared lifecycle email actually has its trigger wired, or it never sends.
gates.name: email-triggers

gates.desc: GA4 / Meta pixel + commerce events wired — revenue is actually tracked.
gates.name: analytics-wiring

gates.desc: Privacy / Terms / Refund / Shipping / Contact exist + are linked — launch-required.
gates.name: legal-pages

gates.desc: GDPR cookie-consent present + not blocking the CTA — compliant for EU/UK/CA.
gates.name: consent
